title: calycomelia alba
intro: Calycomelia alba, commonly known as White Passionflower, is a flowering plant species native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. The plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its potential to reduce anxiety and insomnia due to its calming effects, and its ability to soothe digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Calycomelia alba are attributed to its sedative and antispasmodic properties, which may help alleviate muscle spasms and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
